historyText.default: In 1980, the national SBDC network was established in law around a simple idea: bring the resources of government, universities, and business together to help small businesses succeed.

missionText.default: Here in Northern California, that idea serves a region shaped by innovation — from neighborhood shops and food businesses to manufacturers and technology founders. Our specialized advising programs help entrepreneurs find the expertise their next step calls for.

fundingText.default: Support from the U.S. Small Business Administration, CalOSBA, and local partners makes our no-fee advising possible. It’s a public investment in the people building our communities.

hostLabel.default: Proudly hosted by Cal Poly Humboldt

hostText.default: Through its Sponsored Programs Foundation, Cal Poly Humboldt is home to the Northern California SBDC network — connecting the resources of a public university with the ambitions of local businesses.
